description: Edits one phone number on a contact, as the contact card's Edit phone does: label changes the words beside it, value changes the digits (refused for the contact's preferred number, which changes through edit_client, and for a number the booking software writes back). textThisNumber (true) makes this phone the one Sergio texts. identifierId comes from read (entity client identifiers). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: edit_client_identifier
title: Relabel or renumber a contact's phone
